title: Art Stone
brief_description: Decorative carved stone architectural panel featuring floral and ornamental motifs.
detailed_description: This carved stone panel is an architectural ornament that once formed part of a temple or historic structure. It displays intricate floral scrollwork and a central rosette enclosed within a symmetrical geometric composition, reflecting the craftsmanship of medieval Goan stone artisans. Such architectural panels were commonly used to decorate temple walls, door frames, pillars, and ceilings, serving both structural and decorative purposes. The intricate carvings demonstrate the artistic traditions of the Kadamba period and represent the rich architectural heritage of Goa.
